description: Open (or re-open — idempotent) your Private Log with Stream Presence: a hosted, append-only black box for your own actions. Only your did:key can read it; nobody can edit it. Sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"action": "private_log_open", "did": <your did>} with your Ed25519 key and pass the base64url signature.

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the open call object

name: open_private_log
title: Open your Private Log
